newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Fujimori holds meeting with Japan's Ikeda.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Fujimori holds meeting with Japan's Ikeda.

text.p: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori and Japanese Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda concluded an emergency meeting on the rebel hostage crisis at around 9.30 p.m. EST (0230 GMT) , officials said.
A Government Palace source said the meeting, which also included five members of Ikeda's delgation, was held "in total reserve" and no details of the conversation were known.

Ikeda arrived earlier on Thursday with a delegation of more than 100 people to help negotiations with Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas holding about 400 hostages at the residence of the Japanese ambassador in Lima.
The rebels, who took over the compound in the middle of a reception on Tuesday evening, have threatened to kill hostages if their demands for the release of up to 500 jailed comrades.
They are negotiating with the government through Red Cross officials and a small committee of ambassadors released from the building.
